problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=au+bv+3,\,y=-9u+cv+4
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}1 & 0 \\ -9 & 4\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}3 \\ 4\end{aligned}]
$$

feedback.problem:
The matrix form of the affine transformation

$$
x=au+4v,\,y=-5u+bv+c
$$

is shown below. What is the value of $a+b+c?$

$$
[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ -5 & 3\end{aligned}]\cdot [\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]
$$
feedback.worked_solution:
An affine transformation $T:{R}^{2}\to {R}^{2}$ is a function of the form

$$
x=Au+b,
$$

where $x,u,$ and $b$ are column vectors in ${R}^{2},$ and $A$ is a $2\times 2$ matrix.

We can carry out the matrix operations using the matrix form, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}[\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}] & =\overset{A}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}-3 & 4 \\ -5 & 3\end{aligned}]}}\cdot \overset{u}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}u \\ v\end{aligned}]}}+\overset{b}{\overset{⏞}{[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]}} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-3u+4v \\ -5u+3v\end{aligned}]+[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}-3u+4v \\ -5u+3v\end{aligned}]\end{aligned}
$$

Equating the corresponding elements, we obtain

$$
x=-3u+4v,\,y=-5u+3v+0
$$

Therefore, we have

$$
a+b+c=-3+3+0=0.
$$
